sentences.en: I objected when the waiter tried to remove my plate.
sentences.zh: 当服务员想把我的盘子拿走时，我提出了反对意见。

sentences.en: I don't plan on being a waiter all my life.
sentences.zh: 我不打算一辈子都做服务员。

sentences.en: I worked as a waiter to put myself through college.
sentences.zh: 我在做服务员的工作以供自己上大学。

senses.zh: 服务员，侍者（尤指餐厅男服务员）
